title: Pagination support for Eventstream HTTP connector (Preview)

content.text: You can add an HTTP source to an eventstream (preview) to ingest paginated REST API responses through page-based or cursor-based pagination, eliminating custom orchestration when bringing activity logs, audit records, or operational events into Eventstream.
